items.quote: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
items.claim: Moses objects that the people will not believe him or listen to him, because they will say the LORD has not appeared to him. (The document labels this verse 4:1. Identifying it as Exodus 4:1 comes only from model-prior and is not in the evidence.)
items.action: objected that the people would not believe him or listen to his voice
items.object: the people's expected disbelief that the LORD had appeared to Moses
items.mechanism: expected doubt about whether a divine appearance really happened
